flags.why: The use of chà răng for brushing teeth is mainly Southern, as documented in [this discussion of Southern vocabulary](https://nguoihanoi.vn/doc-dao-phuong-ngu-mien-nam-73332.html).
Một khẩu cơm is unnatural here because this classifier has restricted uses such as pieces of sugarcane or betel, documented in [the dictionary entry](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/kh%E1%BA%A9u).
flags.fix: Mía được tiện thành từng khẩu. = The sugarcane is cut into bite-sized pieces.

flags.why: The religious sense denotes a Buddhist master of monastic discipline, rather than a village ritual priest, as defined in [this Buddhist dictionary](https://blog2.phapthihoi.org/tu-dien-phat-giao/luat-su/).
flags.fix: Buddhist monk specialising in monastic discipline (Vinaya).

flags.why: Performing rites for villagers does not illustrate the documented [Buddhist discipline-master sense](https://blog2.phapthihoi.org/tu-dien-phat-giao/luat-su/).
flags.fix: Vị luật sư giảng về giới luật cho các tăng sinh. = The Vinaya master teaches monastic discipline to the student monks.
